items.title: Gentle approach for anxious dogs
items.text: Owners frequently praise how calm and content their dogs remain during visits. Multiple clients note that anxious or matted pups were quickly put at ease and showed no signs of stress upon pickup.

faq.q: How are owners notified when grooming is finished?
faq.a: Reviewers note that the groomer sends convenient text alerts as soon as dogs are ready for collection.

faq.q: How does the salon accommodate nervous or first-time pets?
faq.a: Clients share that the groomer works gently with anxious and first-time dogs, helping them become comfortable with the grooming routine.
